translation: The high school students' revolt is shaking all of society. The State's response? Send its police to repress them and close the establishments, without success.

title: Lycéens, étudiants, 17 octobre… Pour vivre et non survivre, généralisons la révolte ! — Réunion publique à Paris

translation: Saturday 10 October, France Unbowed calls for participation in the demonstration against the genocide in Gaza and in support of the Palestinian people.

title: 10 octobre : manifestation contre le génocide à Gaza et en solidarité avec le peuple palestinien !

translation: We demand strong and immediate actions from France: Sanctions against Israel, including the immediate suspension of the association agreement between the European Union and Israel.

title: 10 octobre : manifestation contre le génocide à Gaza et en solidarité avec le peuple palestinien !

translation: The cessation of arms trade with Israel, the prohibition of any delivery of arms or military components to Israel, the cessation of arms transit to Israel through French ports

title: Retrait de l’Allemagne du MGCS

speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: C'est l'épilogue d'un mauvais feuilleton dont la France insoumise avait annoncé le dénouement il y a déjà plusieurs années.
translation: This is the epilogue of a bad soap opera whose outcome France Unbowed had announced several years ago.

title: Retrait de l’Allemagne du MGCS
summary: France Unbowed issued a statement criticizing Emmanuel Macron after Germany withdrew from the MGCS future tank project, claiming the party had predicted this outcome years ago and calling for a sovereign, non-aligned defense policy under Jean-Luc Mélenchon's potential presidency.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Aveugle volontaire et obstiné, Emmanuel Macron aura été dupé par des dirigeants allemands froids et déloyaux.
translation: Willfully and stubbornly blind, Emmanuel Macron will have been duped by cold and disloyal German leaders.

title: Retrait de l’Allemagne du MGCS
summary: France Unbowed issued a statement criticizing Emmanuel Macron after Germany withdrew from the MGCS future tank project, claiming the party had predicted this outcome years ago and calling for a sovereign, non-aligned defense policy under Jean-Luc Mélenchon's potential presidency.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Il faut en tirer toute les conséquences pour l'avenir et admettre que notre partenaire d'outre-Rhin est travaillé par des aspirations hégémoniques que les récents succès des néo-nazis rendent particulièrement préoccupantes.
translation: We must draw all the consequences for the future and admit that our partner across the Rhine is driven by hegemonic aspirations that the recent successes of neo-Nazis make particularly worrying.

title: Retrait de l’Allemagne du MGCS
summary: France Unbowed issued a statement criticizing Emmanuel Macron after Germany withdrew from the MGCS future tank project, claiming the party had predicted this outcome years ago and calling for a sovereign, non-aligned defense policy under Jean-Luc Mélenchon's potential presidency.

original_quote: Avec Jean-Luc Mélenchon pour président, la France s'emploiera à consolider une défense souveraine, crédible non-alignée au service de la paix.
translation: With Jean-Luc Mélenchon as president, France will work to consolidate a sovereign, credible, non-aligned defense in the service of peace.

title: Ce 8 octobre, grande mobilisation en soutien aux lycéen·nes et étudiant·es !
summary: France Unbowed announces continued support and participation in youth mobilisations on 8 October and 13 October, demanding improved study conditions, staff recruitment, abolition of Parcoursup, and one-euro meals for all students.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Son accueil si chaleureux dans les cortèges par les plus jeunes témoigne de l'osmose entre la jeunesse du pays et le mouvement insoumis.
translation: His warm welcome in the marches by the youngest testifies to the osmosis between the country's youth and the insoumis movement.

title: Ce 8 octobre, grande mobilisation en soutien aux lycéen·nes et étudiant·es !
summary: France Unbowed announces continued support and participation in youth mobilisations on 8 October and 13 October, demanding improved study conditions, staff recruitment, abolition of Parcoursup, and one-euro meals for all students.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: La France insoumise soutient pleinement cet appel et annonce être présente à leurs côtés, autant pour les soutenir dans leurs revendications que pour les protéger face à la lourde répression du gouvernement.
translation: France Unbowed fully supports this call and announces it will be present at their side, both to support them in their demands and to protect them against the heavy repression of the government.

title: Niche 2026 - En finir avec les amendes abusives
summary: France Unbowed proposes to abolish fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses, arguing they enable police arbitrariness and disproportionately affect precarious and racialized young men, creating debt spirals.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Le développement des amendes forfaitaires délictuelles ces dernières années accompagne la politique pénale répressive et autoritaire de la macronie.
translation: The development of fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses in recent years accompanies the repressive and authoritarian penal policy of Macronism.

title: Niche 2026 - En finir avec les amendes abusives
summary: France Unbowed proposes to abolish fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses, arguing they enable police arbitrariness and disproportionately affect precarious and racialized young men, creating debt spirals.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Nous proposons donc de supprimer les amendes forfaitaires délictuelles.
translation: We therefore propose to abolish fixed-penalty fines for criminal offenses.

title: Niche 2026 - Défiscaliser les pensions alimentaires perçues
summary: France Unbowed presents a bill to exempt child support payments received by custodial parents from taxation, index pensions to inflation, and strengthen family support allowances, addressing precarity of single-parent families.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Aujourd'hui, en plus d'être trop faible (200 euros en moyenne quand un enfant coûte 750 euros) la pension est déduite des revenus du parent qui la verse, mais imposée chez le parent qui la reçoit, dans l'écrasante majorité des cas, la mère.
translation: Today, in addition to being too low (200 euros on average when a child costs 750 euros), the pension is deducted from the income of the parent who pays it, but taxed for the parent who receives it, in the overwhelming majority of cases, the mother.

title: Niche 2026 - Défiscaliser les pensions alimentaires perçues
summary: France Unbowed presents a bill to exempt child support payments received by custodial parents from taxation, index pensions to inflation, and strengthen family support allowances, addressing precarity of single-parent families.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Lors de notre précédente niche, l'obstruction de l'extrême droite nous avait retardé l'examen du texte.
translation: During our previous niche session, the obstruction of the far right had delayed our examination of the text.

title: Niche 2026 - Défiscaliser les pensions alimentaires perçues
summary: France Unbowed presents a bill to exempt child support payments received by custodial parents from taxation, index pensions to inflation, and strengthen family support allowances, addressing precarity of single-parent families.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Portée par la mobilisation des collectifs de mamans solo, cette proposition de loi fait de la pension alimentaire ce qu'elle doit être, un droit de l'enfant.
translation: Supported by the mobilization of single mother collectives, this bill makes child support what it should be, a right of the child.

title: Niche 2026 - Moratoire sur le mégacanal Seine-nord
summary: France Unbowed proposes a bill establishing a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal project, citing ecological concerns including threats to agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity, and water resources.
speaker: Anne Stambach-Terrenoir
original_quote: Notre proposition de loi instaure un moratoire de 10 ans sur le méga-canal Seine-Nord Europe, projet vieux de plus de 40 ans, en contradiction avec l'urgence écologique.
translation: Our bill establishes a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal, a project over 40 years old, in contradiction with the ecological emergency.

title: Niche 2026 - Moratoire sur le mégacanal Seine-nord
summary: France Unbowed proposes a bill establishing a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal project, citing ecological concerns including threats to agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity, and water resources.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Sur 107 kilomètres, ce chantier menace terres agricoles, zones humides, biodiversité et ressource en eau, avec 35 millions de m³ d'eau mobilisés, pour un coût pouvant dépasser 10 milliards d'euros.
translation: Over 107 kilometers, this project threatens agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity and water resources, with 35 million m³ of water mobilized, for a cost that could exceed 10 billion euros.

title: Niche 2026 - Moratoire sur le mégacanal Seine-nord
summary: France Unbowed proposes a bill establishing a 10-year moratorium on the Seine-Nord Europe mega-canal project, citing ecological concerns including threats to agricultural land, wetlands, biodiversity, and water resources.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Pour notre niche parlementaire, nous proposons donc de mettre ce chantier à l'arrêt en suspendant travaux, études, opérations foncières et autorisations.
translation: For our parliamentary niche, we therefore propose to halt this project by suspending works, studies, land operations and authorizations.

title: Niche 2026 - Rétablir le droit commun de la propriété en Outre-mer
summary: France Unbowed proposes to repeal 2024 legislation that reduced the acquisitive prescription period to 10 years in overseas territories, arguing it exposes modest families to land dispossession by speculators and demanding a return to common law.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: En 2024, sans concertation, la prescription acquisitive a été ramenée à 10 ans en outre-mer (contre 30 ans ailleurs).
translation: In 2024, without consultation, the acquisitive prescription was reduced to 10 years in overseas territories (compared to 30 years elsewhere).

title: Niche 2026 - Rétablir le droit commun de la propriété en Outre-mer
summary: France Unbowed proposes to repeal 2024 legislation that reduced the acquisitive prescription period to 10 years in overseas territories, arguing it exposes modest families to land dispossession by speculators and demanding a return to common law.
speaker: France Unbowed
original_quote: Faciliter les sorties d'indivision est nécessaire, mais pas au prix de la dépossession des plus fragiles. Nous demandons donc l'abrogation de ces deux mesures et le retour au droit commun.
translation: Facilitating exits from joint ownership is necessary, but not at the cost of dispossessing the most vulnerable. We therefore demand the repeal of these two measures and a return to common law.

title: Niche parlementaire LFI 2026
summary: France Unbowed announces twelve legislative proposals for their parliamentary niche day on October 29, 2026, including raising minimum wage to 1700 euros net, creating civil servant positions for disabled student accompaniment, and opposing government budget cuts of 43 billion euros.
speaker: Mathilde Panot
original_quote: Ce jeudi 29 octobre 2026 aura lieu la dernière niche du groupe parlementaire La France insoumise avant l'entrée de l'insoumission à l'Elysée.
translation: This Thursday, October 29, 2026 will be the last niche of the France Unbowed parliamentary group before the entry of insoumission into the Élysée.

title: Niche parlementaire LFI 2026
summary: France Unbowed announces twelve legislative proposals for their parliamentary niche day on October 29, 2026, including raising minimum wage to 1700 euros net, creating civil servant positions for disabled student accompaniment, and opposing government budget cuts of 43 billion euros.
speaker: Mathilde Panot
original_quote: Nous proposerons ainsi un texte pour augmenter le salaire minimum à 1700 euros net, augmenter les pensions et indexer les salaires sur l'inflation.
translation: We will thus propose a text to increase the minimum wage to 1700 euros net, increase pensions and index wages to inflation.

title: Niche parlementaire LFI 2026
summary: France Unbowed announces twelve legislative proposals for their parliamentary niche day on October 29, 2026, including raising minimum wage to 1700 euros net, creating civil servant positions for disabled student accompaniment, and opposing government budget cuts of 43 billion euros.
speaker: Mathilde Panot
original_quote: Désormais, alors que tous les services publics s'effondrent, alors que les fonctionnaires, les pompiers, les lycéens, les étudiants et les professeurs crient leur colère, la Macronie annonce un nouveau budget cruel de 43 milliards de coupes
translation: Now, while all public services are collapsing, while civil servants, firefighters, high school students, university students and teachers cry out their anger, the Macronie announces a new cruel budget of 43 billion in cuts

title: DENK |
summary: DENK's website presents the party's core platform advocating for equal opportunities, fighting racism and discrimination, tackling poverty, and fairer wealth distribution in the Netherlands, while listing its three current Members of Parliament.
actors: Stephan van Baarle; Doğukan Ergin; Ismail el Abassi

translation: We fight for a Netherlands in which everyone counts. A country where racism and discrimination are combated, poverty is actively tackled and prosperity is distributed more fairly.

title: Elezioni: con approvazione legge popolo torna sovrano
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announces the definitive approval of a new electoral law that reintroduces preference voting after over thirty years, introduces out-of-residence voting for students and workers, and aims to ensure governmental stability.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: Con l'approvazione definitiva della nuova legge elettorale, quando gli italiani torneranno a votare potranno scegliere tutto: il partito, la coalizione, il programma, il candidato premier e – di nuovo – il proprio parlamentare.
translation: With the definitive approval of the new electoral law, when Italians return to vote they will be able to choose everything: the party, the coalition, the program, the prime ministerial candidate and – again – their own parliamentarian.

title: Elezioni: con approvazione legge popolo torna sovrano
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announces the definitive approval of a new electoral law that reintroduces preference voting after over thirty years, introduces out-of-residence voting for students and workers, and aims to ensure governmental stability.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: Il centrodestra reintroduce il voto di preferenza, che mancava da oltre trent'anni, restituendo ai cittadini il potere di scegliere direttamente chi li rappresenta.
translation: The center-right reintroduces preference voting, which had been missing for over thirty years, returning to citizens the power to directly choose who represents them.

title: Elezioni: con approvazione legge popolo torna sovrano
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announces the definitive approval of a new electoral law that reintroduces preference voting after over thirty years, introduces out-of-residence voting for students and workers, and aims to ensure governmental stability.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: E a chi sperava di vedere il centrodestra diviso, oggi rispondiamo con i fatti: siamo uniti, compatti e determinati a portare avanti gli impegni presi con i cittadini.
translation: And to those who hoped to see the center-right divided, today we respond with facts: we are united, compact and determined to carry forward the commitments made to citizens.

title: Sanità: aumenti fino a 560 euro per personale medico
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced contract renewal for healthcare workers bringing average monthly increases of 393 euros for over 137,000 medical personnel, with potential total increases up to 560 euros.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: Un altro passo concreto per valorizzare chi ogni giorno si prende cura della salute degli italiani. Con il rinnovo del contratto 2025-2027 dell'Area Sanità, che riguarda oltre 137 mila medici e dirigenti sanitari, arrivano aumenti medi di 393 euro al mese per 13 mensilità, ai quali possono aggiungersi ulteriori risorse previste dalla legge, fino a un incremento complessivo di circa 560 euro.
translation: Another concrete step to value those who every day take care of the health of Italians. With the renewal of the 2025-2027 contract for the Health Area, which concerns over 137 thousand doctors and health managers, average increases of 393 euros per month for 13 months are coming, to which additional resources provided by law can be added, up to a total increase of about 560 euros.

title: Sanità: aumenti fino a 560 euro per personale medico
summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced contract renewal for healthcare workers bringing average monthly increases of 393 euros for over 137,000 medical personnel, with potential total increases up to 560 euros.
speaker: Giorgia Meloni
original_quote: Continuiamo a investire sulle professionalità del nostro Servizio sanitario nazionale, riconoscendo il lavoro, le competenze e le responsabilità di chi ogni giorno garantisce assistenza e cure ai cittadini.
translation: We continue to invest in the professionalism of our National Health Service, recognizing the work, skills and responsibilities of those who every day guarantee assistance and care to citizens.

title: Elezioni: voto fuorisede anche per caregiver. Incomprensibile astensione sinistra
summary: Brothers of Italy deputies criticized the opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law, which passed with center-right support and allows Italians to vote outside their residence for reasons including study, work, and caregiving for sick or disabled family members.
speaker: Fabio Roscani
original_quote: L'astensione dell'articolo 8 della legge elettorale da parte dell'opposizione è un gesto incomprensibile e non curante delle esigenze di moltissimi nostri concittadini.
translation: The opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law is an incomprehensible gesture that is uncaring toward the needs of very many of our fellow citizens.

title: Elezioni: voto fuorisede anche per caregiver. Incomprensibile astensione sinistra
summary: Brothers of Italy deputies criticized the opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law, which passed with center-right support and allows Italians to vote outside their residence for reasons including study, work, and caregiving for sick or disabled family members.
speaker: Fabio Roscani
original_quote: Sono fiero che grazie a Fratelli d'Italia ora finalmente anche gli studenti fuorisede potranno finalmente votare ed esprimere le proprie posizioni politiche.
translation: I am proud that thanks to Brothers of Italy, now finally students living away from home will finally be able to vote and express their political positions.

title: Elezioni: voto fuorisede anche per caregiver. Incomprensibile astensione sinistra
summary: Brothers of Italy deputies criticized the opposition's abstention on Article 8 of the electoral law, which passed with center-right support and allows Italians to vote outside their residence for reasons including study, work, and caregiving for sick or disabled family members.
speaker: Grazia Di Maggio
original_quote: Scegliere la via dell'astensione su temi che toccano direttamente le famiglie, la fragilità e il diritto costituzionale al voto significa voltare le spalle a chi ogni giorno affronta prove durissime.
translation: Choosing the path of abstention on issues that directly affect families, fragility, and the constitutional right to vote means turning one's back on those who face the harshest trials every day.

title: 7 ottobre: ricordiamo vittime barbarie Hamas
summary: On the third anniversary of the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks, the Italian government issued a statement commemorating victims, condemning antisemitism, expressing concern for Palestinian civilian suffering in Gaza and the West Bank, and reaffirming commitment to a two-state solution.
speaker: Palazzo Chigi
original_quote: Tre anni fa, il 7 ottobre 2023, gli attacchi terroristici di Hamas massacravano uomini, donne e bambini, aggredivano giovani riuniti per ascoltare musica, strappavano persone innocenti alle loro famiglie per trascinarle nella prigionia.
translation: Three years ago, on 7 October 2023, Hamas terrorist attacks massacred men, women and children, attacked young people gathered to listen to music, tore innocent people from their families to drag them into captivity.

title: 7 ottobre: ricordiamo vittime barbarie Hamas
summary: On the third anniversary of the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks, the Italian government issued a statement commemorating victims, condemning antisemitism, expressing concern for Palestinian civilian suffering in Gaza and the West Bank, and reaffirming commitment to a two-state solution.
speaker: Palazzo Chigi
original_quote: Nessuna causa può giustificare il massacro deliberato di innocenti.
translation: No cause can justify the deliberate massacre of innocents.

title: 7 ottobre: ricordiamo vittime barbarie Hamas

translation: Hambis, one of the most important cultural figures that Cyprus has produced, through the decades of operation of the School and Museum, has contributed decisively to the decentralization of cultural creation, the promotion of the countryside and the advancement of our rich cultural heritage.

translation: AKEL has always emphasized that the presence of military bases on the territory of the Republic of Cyprus is a bad remnant of colonialism and they must be abolished.

title: Η κυβέρνηση να γίνει προστάτης των συμφερόντων της κοινωνίας, όχι δικηγόρος των εταιρειών καυσίμων

translation: It is one thing for the Nikos Christodoulides government to be characterized by an inability to effectively address high prices, it is much worse to consciously provoke society by giving absolution to fuel companies in Cyprus.

title: Σχέδιο Αειφόρου Ανάπτυξης Ακάμα: Ένα ακόμα μνημείο αποτυχίας της διακυβέρνησης Ν. Χριστοδουλίδη
